description: This file implements the retention policy store for Mattermost, including CRUD operations, policy management, and cleanup of orphaned rows, with focus on retention policies for channels and teams.

classes.name: SqlRetentionPolicyStore
classes.description: Struct implementing retention policy storage with methods for CRUD and cleanup operations.

methods.name: newSqlRetentionPolicyStore
methods.description: Constructor for SqlRetentionPolicyStore.

methods.name: Save
methods.description: Creates a new retention policy with associated channels and teams.

methods.name: checkTeamsExist
methods.description: Verifies that specified team IDs exist.

methods.name: checkChannelsExist
methods.description: Verifies that specified channel IDs exist.

methods.name: buildInsertRetentionPoliciesChannelsQuery
methods.description: Builds SQL query to insert channels into retention policy.

methods.name: buildInsertRetentionPoliciesTeamsQuery
methods.description: Builds SQL query to insert teams into retention policy.

methods.name: Patch
methods.description: Updates an existing retention policy and its associated channels and teams.

methods.name: buildGetPolicyQuery
methods.description: Builds SQL query to retrieve a specific retention policy.

methods.name: buildGetPoliciesQuery
methods.description: Builds SQL query to retrieve multiple retention policies.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a retention policy by ID.

methods.name: GetAll
methods.description: Retrieves all retention policies with pagination.

methods.name: GetCount
methods.description: Returns total count of retention policies.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a retention policy by ID.

methods.name: GetChannels
methods.description: Retrieves channels associated with a retention policy.

methods.name: GetChannelsCount
methods.description: Counts channels associated with a retention policy.

methods.name: AddChannels
methods.description: Adds channels to a retention policy.

methods.name: RemoveChannels
methods.description: Removes channels from a retention policy.

methods.name: GetTeams
methods.description: Retrieves teams associated with a retention policy.

methods.name: GetTeamsCount
methods.description: Counts teams associated with a retention policy.

methods.name: AddTeams
methods.description: Adds teams to a retention policy.

methods.name: RemoveTeams
methods.description: Removes teams from a retention policy.

methods.name: GetTeamPoliciesForUser
methods.description: Retrieves retention policies applicable to a user based on team membership.

methods.name: GetTeamPoliciesCountForUser
methods.description: Counts retention policies applicable to a user based on team membership.

methods.name: GetChannelPoliciesForUser
methods.description: Retrieves retention policies applicable to a user based on channel membership.

methods.name: GetChannelPoliciesCountForUser
methods.description: Counts retention policies applicable to a user based on channel membership.

methods.description: Retrieves IDs for deletion for a specific table.

methods.description: Performs batch deletion of records based on retention policies.
